name: varint
description: Variable-length integer encoding and decoding in protobuf-style, supporting both unsigned and signed (ZigZag) varints.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when implementing protocol buffers, custom binary protocols, or any scenario where you want to compactly encode integers of varying magnitude. Small integers take fewer bytes. Supports ZigZag encoding for efficiently encoding negative signed integers.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: The byte buffer to decode a varint from.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Byte offset into the buffer to start decoding from. Defaults to 0.
